Wahan mat jaiye jahan raasta le jaaye, balki wahan jaiye jahan koi raasta na ho aur apna nishaan chhodiye.
Motivation jeet leti hai, jab talent kaam nahi karta.
Failure sirf naya start karne ka opportunity hai.
Badlaav ke alawa kuch bhi sthayi nahi hai.
Tum apne goals ke level tak nahi uthte; tum apne systems ke level tak girte ho.
Kal ki realization ki limit aaj ke shaks hain.
Success choti choti efforts ka sum hai, roz repeat karke.
Wo badlav bano jo duniya mein dekhna chahte ho.
"Jeet ya haar—tum yaad kiye jaoge."
